title: Adi-khanda, part 7 (portion 15)
html:
Pauganda-lila (continued): Vishvambhara's upanayana; during the rite He is overcome by the ecstasy of prema, and the astonished pandits reason about the avataras for a special purpose and the yuga-avataras, about Krishna in the Dvapara and Gaura in the Kali, about Radha and the dharma of service, and conclude that Vishvambhara is the Lord Himself

Raga varadi; disha: "Gorachand is my life!"

এইমতে আনন্দে সানন্দে দিন যায় ।
নদীয়ানগর সুখসাগরে ভাসায় ॥ ৫১৭ ॥

eimate ānande sānande dina yāẏa |
nadīẏānagara sukhasāgare bhāsāẏa || 517 ||

eimate — thus; anande sanande — in joy and gladness; dina yaya — the days pass; nadiya-nagara — the town of Nadia; sukhasagare bhasaya — floats in an ocean of happiness

517Thus in joy and gladness the days pass;
the town of Nadia floats in an ocean of happiness.

তিলেকের যত সুখ কে কহিতে পারে ।
শচী-জগন্নাথ-ভাগ্য ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে ॥ ৫১৮ ॥

tilekera yata sukha ke kahite pāre |
śacī-jagannātha-bhāgya brahmāṇḍe nā dhare || 518 ||

tilekera yata sukha — the happiness of a moment; ke kahite pare — who can tell; shachi-jagannatha-bhagya — the fortune of Shachi and Jagannatha; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot contain

518Who can tell the happiness of a single moment!
The good fortune of Shachi and Jagannatha cannot be contained in the universe.

একদিন বয়স্যের সঙ্গে আচম্বিত ।
জগন্নাথ দেখিল তনয় সুচরিত ॥ ৫১৯ ॥

ekadina baẏasyera saṅge ācambita |
jagannātha dekhila tanaẏa sucarita || 519 ||

ekadina — one day; vayasyera sange — among companions; achambita — suddenly; jagannatha dekhila — Jagannatha saw; tanaya sucharita — his well-mannered son

519One day Jagannatha suddenly saw
his well-mannered son among His companions.

নবম বরিষ পুত্র যোগ্য সুসময় ।
উপবীত দিব বলি চিন্তিল হৃদয় ॥ ৫২০ ॥

nabama bariṣa putra yogya susamaẏa |
upabīta diba bali cintila hṛdaẏa || 520 ||

navama barisha putra — the son in his ninth year; yogya susamaya — a fitting, auspicious time; upavita diba bali — "I shall give the sacred thread"; chintila hridaya — he thought in his heart

520The son is in His ninth year — a fitting and auspicious time;
"I shall give Him the sacred thread," he thought in his heart.

ঘরে আসি শচী-সনে যুকতি করিল ।
দৈবজ্ঞ আনিঞা শুভদিন যে রচিল ॥ ৫২১ ॥

ghare āsi śacī-sane yukati karila |
daibajña āniñā śubhadina ye racila || 521 ||

ghare asi — coming home; shachi-sane yukati karila — took counsel with Shachi; daivajna anina — calling an astrologer; shubhadina ye rachila — fixed an auspicious day

521Coming home, he took counsel with Shachi,
called an astrologer and fixed an auspicious day.

ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব আনি নিবেদিল কথা ।
আজ্ঞা কর দিব বিশ্বম্ভরের পইতা ॥ ৫২২ ॥

iṣṭa-kuṭumba āni nibedila kathā |
ājñā kara diba biśbambharera paitā || 522 ||

ishta-kutumba ani — gathering friends and kinsfolk; nivedila katha — announced; ajna kara — give leave; diba vishvambharera paita — I shall invest Vishvambhara with the sacred thread

522Gathering friends and kinsfolk, he announced to them:
"Give me leave to invest Vishvambhara with the sacred thread."

মিশ্র আচার্য আনি খ্যাত যে পণ্ডিত ।
যজ্ঞকর্ম জানে যেই জানয়ে বেদরীত ॥ ৫২৩ ॥

miśra ācārya āni khyāta ye paṇḍita |
yajñakarma jāne yei jānaẏe bedarīta || 523 ||

mishra acharya ani — Mishra, engaging as acharya; khyata ye pandita — a famous pandit; yajna-karma jane yei — who knows the rites of sacrifice; janaye veda-rita — knows the Vedic ordinances

523Mishra engaged as acharya a famous pandit
who knows the rites of sacrifice and knows the Vedic ordinances.

গুবাক চন্দন মালা ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল ।
শত শত কুলবধূ সিন্দুর পরিল ॥ ৫২৪ ॥

gubāka candana mālā brāhmaṇere dila |
śata śata kulabadhū sindura parila || 524 ||

guvaka chandana mala — betel nuts, sandal, garlands; brahmanere dila — gave to the brahmanas; shata shata kulavadhu — hundreds of respectable women; sindura parila — put on sindura

524To the brahmanas were given betel nuts, sandal and garlands;
hundreds of respectable women put on sindura.

খদিকা কদলক আর তৈল হরিদ্রা ।
প্রত্যেকে সভারে দিল শচী সুচরিতা ॥ ৫২৫ ॥

khadikā kadalaka āra taila haridrā |
pratyeke sabhāre dila śacī sucaritā || 525 ||

khadika — puffed rice (khai); kadalaka — bananas; ara taila haridra — and oil and turmeric; pratyeke sabhare dila — gave to each and every one; shachi sucharita — virtuous Shachi

525Puffed rice, bananas, oil and turmeric
the virtuous Shachi gave to each and every one.

শঙ্খ-শবদ হুলাহুলি জয় জয় ।
গন্ধ-অধিবাস করে গোধূলি সময় ॥ ৫২৬ ॥

śaṅkha-śabada hulāhuli jaẏa jaẏa |
gandha-adhibāsa kare godhūli samaẏa || 526 ||

shankha-shabada — the sound of conches; hulahuli jaya jaya — women's ululation, "jaya, jaya"; gandha-adhivasa kare — they perform the anointing with fragrance (adhivasa); godhuli samaya — at the hour of dusk

526Conches sound, the women's cries of "Jaya, jaya!" ring out;
at the hour of dusk they perform the rite of anointing with fragrances (adhivasa).1

ব্রাহ্মণে বেদ পড়ে ভাটে রায়বার ।
আশীর্বাদ দিঞা কৈল যে বিধি আচার ॥ ৫২৭ ॥

brāhmaṇe beda paṛe bhāṭe rāẏabāra |
āśīrbāda diñā kaila ye bidhi ācāra || 527 ||

brahmane veda pade — the brahmanas recite the Vedas; bhate rayabara — the bards their eulogies; ashirvada dina — giving blessings; kaila ye vidhi achara — did according to rule and custom

527The brahmanas recite the Vedas, the bhat bards their eulogies;
giving blessings, they did all according to rule and custom.

রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে উঠি মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
নান্দীমুখ শ্রাদ্ধবিধি করিল সুন্দর ॥ ৫২৮ ॥

rātri suprabhāte uṭhi miśra purandara |
nāndīmukha śrāddhabidhi karila sundara || 528 ||

ratri suprabhate uthi — rising at daybreak; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; nandimukha shraddha-vidhi — the rite of nandimukha-shraddha; karila sundara — performed beautifully

528Rising at daybreak, Mishra Purandara
performed the nandimukha-shraddha beautifully.2

ব্রাহ্মণ পূজিল পাদ্য আচমন দিয়া ।
যজ্ঞকর্ম আরম্ভিল সময় বুঝিয়া ॥ ৫২৯ ॥

brāhmaṇa pūjila pādya ācamana diẏā |
yajñakarma ārambhila samaẏa bujhiẏā || 529 ||

brahmana pujila — honoured the brahmanas; padya achamana diya — offering water for the feet and for sipping; yajna-karma arambhila — began the sacrificial rite; samaya bujhiya — judging the time

529Having honoured the brahmanas with water for the feet and for sipping,
judging the time had come, he began the sacrificial rite.

এথা শচীদেবী যত আইহ সুইহ লঞা ।
পুত্র-মহোৎসবে বুলে কৌতুক করিয়া ॥ ৫৩০ ॥

ethā śacīdebī yata āiha suiha lañā |
putra-mahotsabe bule kautuka kariẏā || 530 ||

etha — here, meanwhile; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; yata aiha suiha lana — with all the married women; putra-mahotsave — at her son's festival; bule kautuka kariya — goes about making merry

530Here, meanwhile, Shachi-devi with all the married women
goes about making merry at her son's festival.

নাগরীর গণ যত গৌরাঙ্গ বেঢ়িল ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ মাজনা করিবার মন কৈল ॥ ৫৩০+১ ॥

nāgarīra gaṇa yata gaurāṅga beṛhila |
śrīaṅga mājanā karibāra mana kaila || 530+1 ||

nagarira gana yata — all the nagaris, as many as there were; gauranga bedhila — surrounded Gauranga; sri-anga majana karibara — to anoint (rub) the holy body; mana kaila — wished

530+1All the nagaris, as many as there were, surrounded Gauranga3
and wished to anoint His holy body.

তৈল হরিদ্রা বিশ্বম্ভর-অঙ্গে দিল ।
গন্ধ-আমলকী দিয়া মস্তক মাজিল ॥ ৫৩১ ॥

taila haridrā biśbambhara-aṅge dila |
gandha-āmalakī diẏā mastaka mājila || 531 ||

taila haridra — oil and turmeric; vishvambhara-ange dila — applied to Vishvambhara's body; gandha-amalaki diya — with fragrant amalaki; mastaka majila — washed His head

531They anointed Vishvambhara's body with oil and turmeric,
washed His head with fragrant amalaki

অভিষেক করাইলা সুরনদী-জলে ।
আপনা পাশরে শচী আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ৫৩২ ॥

abhiṣeka karāilā suranadī-jale |
āpanā pāśare śacī ānanda-hillole || 532 ||

abhisheka karaila — bathed Him ceremonially; suranadi-jale — with water of the heavenly river; apana pasare shachi — Shachi forgets herself; ananda-hillole — in waves of joy

532and bathed Him with water of the heavenly river;
Shachi forgets herself in waves of joy.

শঙ্খ দুন্দুভি বাজে ভেউর কাহাল ।
মৃদঙ্গ পটহ বাজে কাংস্য করতাল ॥ ৫৩৩ ॥

śaṅkha dundubhi bāje bheura kāhāla |
mṛdaṅga paṭaha bāje kāṃsya karatāla || 533 ||

shankha dundubhi baje — conches and dundubhis sound; bheura kahala — bheur and kahal horns; mridanga pataha baje — mridangas and patahas sound; kamsya karatala — bronze cymbals

533Conches, dundubhis, bheur and kahal horns resound;
mridangas, patahas and bronze cymbals resound.

ঢাকের দুড়দুড়ি শুনি যোজনেক পথে ।
শুনিঞা জুড়ায় হিয়া সাহিনী-শবদে ॥ ৫৩৪ ॥

ḍhākera duṛaduṛi śuni yojaneka pathe |
śuniñā juṛāẏa hiẏā sāhinī-śabade || 534 ||

dhakera duduri — the rumble of the dhak drums; shuni yojaneka pathe — is heard a yojana away; shuniya juraya hiya — hearing, the heart is soothed; sahini-shabade — by the sound of the sahini (sanai)

534The rumble of the dhak drums is heard a yojana away;
at the sound of the sahini the heart is gladdened.

বীণা বেণু কপিলাস বংশীর নিসান ।
রবাব উপাঙ্গ পাখোয়াজ একতান ॥ ৫৩৫ ॥

bīṇā beṇu kapilāsa baṃśīra nisāna |
rabāba upāṅga pākhoẏāja ekatāna || 535 ||

vina venu — vinas, flutes; kapilasa — kapilasa horns; vamshira nisana — pipes, nisan drums; rababa upanga pakhoyaja — rababs, upangas, pakhoyajes; ekatana — in unison

535Vinas, flutes, kapilasa horns, pipes, nisan drums,
rababs, upangas and pakhoyajes play in unison.

নর্তক নাচয়ে গীত গাএ ত গায়ন ।
শুভক্ষণ করি কৈল মস্তকমুণ্ডন ॥ ৫৩৬ ॥

nartaka nācaẏe gīta gāe ta gāẏana |
śubhakṣaṇa kari kaila mastakamuṇḍana || 536 ||

nartaka nachaye — dancers dance; gita gae ta gayana — singers sing songs; shubhakshana kari — at an auspicious moment; kaila mastaka-mundana — shaved His head

536Dancers dance, singers sing songs;
at an auspicious moment His head was shaved.

প্রতি অঙ্গে অলঙ্কার ভূষণ করিল ।
গন্ধ মাল্য চন্দনেতে সুবেশ রচিল ॥ ৫৩৭ ॥

prati aṅge alaṅkāra bhūṣaṇa karila |
gandha mālya candanete subeśa racila || 537 ||

prati ange — on every limb; alankara bhushana karila — put ornaments; gandha malya chandanete — with perfumes, garlands and sandal; suvesha rachila — dressed Him beautifully

537Every limb of His was adorned with ornaments,
and He was dressed in perfumes, garlands and sandal.

যজ্ঞস্থানে লঞা আইলা শচীর নন্দনে ।
যথা বেদধ্বনি করে ব্রাহ্মণের গণে ॥ ৫৩৮ ॥

yajñasthāne lañā āilā śacīra nandane |
yathā bedadhbani kare brāhmaṇera gaṇe || 538 ||

yajnasthane lana aila — brought to the place of sacrifice; shachira nandane — Shachi's son; yatha vedadhvani kare — where chant the Vedas; brahmanera gane — the host of brahmanas

538Shachi's son was brought to the place of sacrifice,
where the host of brahmanas chant the Vedas.

রক্তবস্ত্র উপবীত পরাইল অঙ্গে ।
রূপ দেখি ভুলি গেলা আপনে অনঙ্গে ॥ ৫৩৯ ॥

raktabastra upabīta parāila aṅge |
rūpa dekhi bhuli gelā āpane anaṅge || 539 ||

raktavastra upavita — red garments and the sacred thread; paraila ange — put on His body; rupa dekhi — seeing the beauty; bhuli gela apane anange — Ananga himself was entranced

539They clothed Him in red garments and the sacred thread;
seeing His beauty, Ananga (Kamadeva) himself was entranced.

বিশ্বম্ভর-কর্ণে মন্ত্র কহে তার বাপ ।
দণ্ড করে দেখি ডরে ডরাইল পাপ ॥ ৫৪০ ॥

biśbambhara-karṇe mantra kahe tāra bāpa |
daṇḍa kare dekhi ḍare ḍarāila pāpa || 540 ||

vishvambhara-karne — into Vishvambhara's ear; mantra kahe tara bapa — His father speaks the mantra; danda kare dekhi — seeing the staff in His hand; dare daraila papa — sin trembled with fear

540His father speaks the mantra into Vishvambhara's ear;
seeing the staff in His hand, sin itself trembled with fear.

ভিক্ষা মাগয়ে প্রভু আশ্রম-আচার ।
সন্ন্যাস-আশ্রম সর্ব-আশ্রমের সার ॥ ৫৪১ ॥

bhikṣā māgaẏe prabhu āśrama-ācāra |
sannyāsa-āśrama sarba-āśramera sāra || 541 ||

bhiksha magaye prabhu — the Lord begs alms; ashrama-achara — the custom of the ashrama; sannyasa-ashrama — the sannyasa ashrama; sarva-ashramera sara — the essence of all ashramas

541The Lord begs alms — such is the custom of this ashrama;
the sannyasa ashrama is the essence of all ashramas.

যুগধর্মে সন্ন্যাস করিব মনে ছিল ।
মুণ্ডনের কালে সেই মনেতে পড়িল ॥ ৫৪২ ॥

yugadharme sannyāsa kariba mane chila |
muṇḍanera kāle sei manete paṛila || 542 ||

yugadharme — for the dharma of the age; sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; mane chhila — was in His mind; mundanera kale — at the time of the shaving; sei manete padila — that came to His mind

542It was in His mind: "For the dharma of the age I shall take sannyasa,"
and at the time His head was shaved, He remembered it.4

এমন হইব বলি হইল আবেশ ।
কলি-সর্বজনে ভ্রমি ঘুচাইব ক্লেশ ॥ ৫৪৩ ॥

emana haiba bali haila ābeśa |
kali-sarbajane bhrami ghucāiba kleśa || 543 ||

emana haiba bali — saying "so I shall be"; haila avesha — ecstasy arose; kali-sarvajane — of all the people of Kali; bhrami — wandering; ghuchaiba klesha — I shall dispel the sufferings

543"So I shall do," and ecstasy seized Him:
"Wandering, I shall dispel the sufferings of all the people of Kali!"

পুলকিত সর্ব অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ।
কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি একটি পুলক ॥ ৫৪৪ ॥

pulakita sarba aṅga āpāda-mastaka |
kadamba-keśara jini ekaṭi pulaka || 544 ||

pulakita sarva anga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka — from foot to head; kadamba-keshara jini — surpassing the kadamba filament; ekati pulaka — each single bristling hair

544His whole body thrills from head to foot;
each single bristling hair surpasses the filaments of the kadamba.

করুণ অরুণ দুই দীঘল লোচন ।
বাল-দিনকর যেন অঙ্গের কিরণ ॥ ৫৪৫ ॥

karuṇa aruṇa dui dīghala locana |
bāla-dinakara yena aṅgera kiraṇa || 545 ||

karuna aruna — compassionate, reddish; dui dighala lochana — two long eyes; bala-dinakara yena — like the rising sun; angera kirana — the radiance of the body

545His two long eyes are compassionate and reddish;
the radiance of His body is like the rising sun.

প্রেমারম্ভে মহাদম্ভ হুঙ্কার গর্জন ।
চমক লাগিল দেখি সকল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৫৪৬ ॥

premārambhe mahādambha huṅkāra garjana |
camaka lāgila dekhi sakala brāhmaṇa || 546 ||

premarambhe — at the onset of prema; mahadambha — great and proud; hunkara garjana — roaring and thundering; chamaka lagila — were astounded; dekhi sakala brahmana — seeing, all the brahmanas

546At the onset of prema — a great, proud, thundering roar;
seeing this, all the brahmanas were astounded.

সুদর্শন-আদি যত পণ্ডিত প্রধান ।
একত্র হইয়া সভে করে অনুমান ॥ ৫৪৭ ॥

sudarśana-ādi yata paṇḍita pradhāna |
ekatra haiẏā sabhe kare anumāna || 547 ||

sudarshana-adi — Sudarshana and others; yata pandita pradhana — the leading pandits; ekatra haiya — gathering together; sabhe kare anumana — all reason

547Sudarshana5 and the other leading pandits,
gathering together, reason among themselves:

সকল পণ্ডিত মিলি করয়ে বিচার ।
মানুষ না হয় এই শচীর কুমার ॥ ৫৪৮ ॥

sakala paṇḍita mili karaẏe bicāra |
mānuṣa nā haẏa ei śacīra kumāra || 548 ||

sakala pandita mili — all the pandits meeting; karaye vichara — deliberate; manusha na haya — is not a human being; ei shachira kumara — this son of Shachi

548all the pandits, meeting together, deliberate:
"This son of Shachi is not a human being.

কোন দেবতার তেজ জানিল নিশ্চয় ।
এ তেজ গোবিন্দ বিনু আর কারু নয় ॥ ৫৪৯ ॥

kona debatāra teja jānila niścaẏa |
e teja gobinda binu āra kāru naẏa || 549 ||

kona devatara teja — the effulgence of some god; janila nishchaya — they understood for certain; e teja — this effulgence; govinda vinu — apart from Govinda; ara karu naya — belongs to no one else

549This is the effulgence of some god," they understood with certainty;
"such effulgence can belong to none but Govinda.

আমরা কি জানি প্রভুর চরিত্র আচার ।
অনুমান করি সভে বুদ্ধির বিচার ॥ ৫৫০ ॥

āmarā ki jāni prabhura caritra ācāra |
anumāna kari sabhe buddhira bicāra || 550 ||

amara ki jani — what do we know; prabhura charitra achara — of the Lord's deeds and conduct; anumana kari sabhe — we all conjecture; buddhira vichara — by the reasoning of the intellect

550What do we know of the Lord's deeds and conduct?
We only conjecture by the reasoning of our intellect."

একজন বোলে শুন আমার বচন ।
না বুঝিয়ে এই দৃঢ় প্রভুর আচরণ ॥ ৫৫১ ॥

ekajana bole śuna āmāra bacana |
nā bujhiẏe ei dṛṛha prabhura ācaraṇa || 551 ||

ekajana bole — one said; shuna amara vachana — hear my words; na bujhiye — we do not understand; ei dridha — this is certain; prabhura acharana — the Lord's conduct

551One said: "Listen to my words:
the Lord's deeds we do not understand — that is certain.

যে কিছু কহিয়ে শুন আপনার মর্ম ।
লোক নিস্তারিতে প্রভু যুগে যুগে জন্ম ॥ ৫৫২ ॥

ye kichu kahiẏe śuna āpanāra marma |
loka nistārite prabhu yuge yuge janma || 552 ||

ye kichhu kahiye shuna — hear what I say; apanara marma — my own understanding; loka nistarite — to deliver the people; prabhu yuge yuge janma — the Lord is born age after age

552Listen to what I say, as I myself understand it:
to deliver the people, the Lord takes birth age after age.

কত কত অবতার কার্য-অনুসারে ।
যুগের স্বভাবে সবে চারি অবতারে ॥ ৫৫৩ ॥

kata kata abatāra kārya-anusāre |
yugera sbabhābe sabe cāri abatāre || 553 ||

kata kata avatara — many avataras; karya-anusare — according to purpose; yugera svabhave — by the nature of the yugas; sabe chari avatare — only four avataras

553There are many avataras, according to the purpose for which they come;
but according to the nature of the yugas there are only four avataras.6

ধর্মসংস্থাপন আর অধর্ম-বিনাশে ।
সাধুজন-পরিত্রাণ-হেতু পরকাশে ॥ ৫৫৪ ॥

dharmasaṃsthāpana āra adharma-bināśe |
sādhujana-paritrāṇa-hetu parakāśe || 554 ||

dharma-samsthapana — to establish dharma; ara adharma-vinashe — and to destroy adharma; sadhujana-paritrana-hetu — for the deliverance of the righteous; parakashe — He appears

554To establish dharma, to destroy adharma
and to deliver the righteous, He appears.

অসুর-সংহার হেতু আদি যত আর ।
কার্য-অবতার বলি এ নাম তাহার ॥ ৫৫৫ ॥

asura-saṃhāra hetu ādi yata āra |
kārya-abatāra bali e nāma tāhāra || 555 ||

asura-samhara hetu adi — for slaying asuras and the like; yata ara — all the others; karya-avatara bali — called karya-avataras; e nama tahara — such is their name

555Those who come to slay the asuras and the like
are called avataras for a special purpose (karya-avataras).

শ্রীরাম-আদি যত অবতার লেখি ।
কার্য-অবতার তার কার্যে পাই সাক্ষী ॥ ৫৫৬ ॥

śrīrāma-ādi yata abatāra lekhi |
kārya-abatāra tāra kārye pāi sākṣī || 556 ||

shrirama-adi — beginning with Sri Rama; yata avatara lekhi — all the avataras written of; karya-avatara — are karya-avataras; tara karye pai sakshi — in their deeds we find the witness

556All the avataras that are written of, beginning with Sri Rama,
are karya-avataras: their deeds bear witness to it.

ত্রেতাযুগে রক্তবর্ণ যজ্ঞ তার ধর্ম ।
দূর্বাদলশ্যাম প্রভু রাক্ষস-ক্ষয় কর্ম ॥ ৫৫৭ ॥

tretāyuge raktabarṇa yajña tāra dharma |
dūrbādalaśyāma prabhu rākṣasa-kṣaẏa karma || 557 ||

tretayuge — in the Treta-yuga; raktavarna — red in colour; yajna tara dharma — its dharma is sacrifice; durvadala-shyama prabhu — the Lord dark as durva grass; rakshasa-kshaya karma — the task of destroying the rakshasas

557In the Treta-yuga [the yuga-avatara] is red, its dharma is sacrifice;
the Lord, dark as a blade of durva grass, [came] to destroy the rakshasas.

সকল ত্রেতায় সে না হয় রঘুনাথ ।
রাবণ বধিতে খেলা বানরের সাথ ॥ ৫৫৮ ॥

sakala tretāẏa se nā haẏa raghunātha |
rābaṇa badhite khelā bānarera sātha || 558 ||

sakala tretaya — in every Treta; se na haya raghunatha — Raghunatha does not appear; ravana vadhite — to slay Ravana; khela vanarera satha — playing with the monkeys

558Not in every Treta does Raghunatha appear
to play with the monkeys in order to slay Ravana.

চৌদ্দ চৌযুগ সে রাবণের পরমাই ।
কত কত ত্রেতা গেল লেখা কর ভাই ॥ ৫৫৯ ॥

caudda cauyuga se rābaṇera paramāi |
kata kata tretā gela lekhā kara bhāi || 559 ||

chaudda chauyuga — fourteen chatur-yugas; se ravanera paramai — is Ravana's lifespan; kata kata treta gela — how many Tretas went by; lekha kara bhai — count, brothers

559Ravana's lifespan is fourteen chatur-yugas;
count, brothers, how many Tretas went by!

এতেকে বোলিয়ে সব ত্রেতা এক নহে ।
কার্য-অনুসারে বলি যখন যে হয়ে ॥ ৫৬০ ॥

eteke boliẏe saba tretā eka nahe |
kārya-anusāre bali yakhana ye haẏe || 560 ||

eteke boliye — therefore I say; saba treta eka nahe — not all Tretas are the same; karya-anusare bali — I say: according to purpose; yakhana ye haye — depending on what happens when

560That is why I say: not all Tretas are the same —
[the avataras come] according to purpose, depending on what happens when.

সত্যে শ্বেত তপোধর্ম হংস-নাম জানি ।
নৃসিংহাদি অবতার কার্য অনুমানি ॥ ৫৬১ ॥

satye śbeta tapodharma haṃsa-nāma jāni |
nṛsiṃhādi abatāra kārya anumāni || 561 ||

satye shveta — in the Satya white; tapo-dharma — the dharma is austerity; hamsa-nama jani — I know the name Hamsa; nrisimhadi avatara — Nrisimha and the other avataras; karya anumani — I consider [avataras for a] purpose

561In the Satya-yuga [the avatara] is white, the dharma is austerity, the name Hamsa;
Nrisimha and the others I consider karya-avataras.

যুগ-অনুরূপ বর্ণ ধর্মসংস্থাপন ।
যুগ-অবতার বলি জানিয়ে সে জন ॥ ৫৬২ ॥

yuga-anurūpa barṇa dharmasaṃsthāpana |
yuga-abatāra bali jāniẏe se jana || 562 ||

yuga-anurupa varna — a colour befitting the yuga; dharma-samsthapana — establishing dharma; yuga-avatara bali — as the yuga-avatara; janiye se jana — I know him

562He who, with a colour befitting the yuga, establishes [its] dharma —
him I know as the avatara of the yuga (yuga-avatara).

দ্বাপরে কৃষ্ণের কথা শুন একমনে ।
একলা ঠাকুর সেই নাহি অন্যজনে ॥ ৫৬৩ ॥

dbāpare kṛṣṇera kathā śuna ekamane |
ekalā ṭhākura sei nāhi anyajane || 563 ||

dvapare krishnera katha — about Krishna in the Dvapara; shuna ekamane — listen attentively; ekala thakura sei — He alone is the Lord; nahi anyajane — there is no other

563Listen attentively about Krishna in the Dvapara:
He alone is the Lord, and no one else.

কার্য-অবতার কিবা যুগ-অবতার ।
সর্বকলা-পূর্ণ সেই নন্দের কুমার ॥ ৫৬৪ ॥

kārya-abatāra kibā yuga-abatāra |
sarbakalā-pūrṇa sei nandera kumāra || 564 ||

karya-avatara kiva yuga-avatara — whether karya-avatara or yuga-avatara; sarvakala-purna — full of all parts; sei nandera kumara — He, Nanda's son

564Whether karya-avatara or yuga-avatara —
the son of Nanda is full of all the parts (kalas).

পূর্ণ পূর্ণব্রহ্ম যারে বোলে সর্বজনে ।
গোপিকা-লম্পট সেই জানিহ বৃন্দাবনে ॥ ৫৬৫ ॥

pūrṇa pūrṇabrahma yāre bole sarbajane |
gopikā-lampaṭa sei jāniha bṛndābane || 565 ||

purna purnabrahma — the full, complete Brahman; yare bole sarvajane — whom all call; gopika-lampata — avid for the gopis; sei janiha vrindavane — know Him in Vrindavana

565Him all call the full, complete Brahman;
know that in Vrindavana He is the One who longs for the gopis' love.7

অবতার-শিরোমণি কৃষ্ণ-অবতার ।
দ্বাপর-ভিতরে এই দ্বাপর যে সার ॥ ৫৬৬ ॥

abatāra-śiromaṇi kṛṣṇa-abatāra |
dbāpara-bhitare ei dbāpara ye sāra || 566 ||

avatara-shiromani — the crown of avataras; krishna-avatara — Krishna's avatara; dvapara-bhitare — among the Dvaparas; ei dvapara ye sara — this Dvapara is the best

566The avatara of Krishna is the crown of all avataras;
among the Dvaparas this Dvapara is the best.

আর দ্বাপরে আছে অবতার দুই ।
কার্য-অবতার কিবা যুগাবতার এই ॥ ৫৬৭ ॥

āra dbāpare āche abatāra dui |
kārya-abatāra kibā yugābatāra ei || 567 ||

ara dvapare — in other Dvaparas; achhe avatara dui — there are two [kinds of] avataras; karya-avatara kiva — either karya-avatara; yugavatara ei — or this yuga-avatara

567In other Dvaparas there are two [kinds of] avataras:
either a karya-avatara or a yuga-avatara.

যেই দ্বাপরে হয় কৃষ্ণ-অবতার ।
সেই কলিযুগে গৌরচান্দের প্রচার ॥ ৫৬৮ ॥

yei dbāpare haẏa kṛṣṇa-abatāra |
sei kaliyuge gauracāndera pracāra || 568 ||

yei dvapare — in the Dvapara in which; haya krishna-avatara — Krishna descends; sei kaliyuge — in that Kali-yuga; gaurachandera prachara — Gaurachand is manifest

568In the Kali-yuga that follows the Dvapara in which Krishna descends,
Gaurachand appears.8

যেন কৃষ্ণ-অবতার তেন গৌরচন্দ্র ।
এই দুই যুগ সব যুগের স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৫৬৯ ॥

yena kṛṣṇa-abatāra tena gauracandra |
ei dui yuga saba yugera sbatantra || 569 ||

yena krishna-avatara — as is the Krishna-avatara; tena gaurachandra — so is Gaurachandra; ei dui yuga — these two yugas; saba yugera svatantra — are distinct from all yugas

569As is the Krishna-avatara, so is Gaurachandra;
these two yugas are distinct from all the yugas.

সব দ্বাপরে নাহি কৃষ্ণের বিহার ।
সব কলিযুগে নাহি গোরা-অবতার ॥ ৫৭০ ॥

saba dbāpare nāhi kṛṣṇera bihāra |
saba kaliyuge nāhi gorā-abatāra || 570 ||

saba dvapare nahi — not in every Dvapara; krishnera vihara — are Krishna's pastimes; saba kaliyuge nahi — not in every Kali-yuga; gora-avatara — is Gora's descent

570Not in every Dvapara are there Krishna's pastimes,
not in every Kali-yuga does Gora descend.

কতেক দ্বাপর কলি সত্য ত্রেতা যায় ।
অংশ-অবতার প্রভু হয় তা-সভায় ॥ ৫৭১ ॥

kateka dbāpara kali satya tretā yāẏa |
aṃśa-abatāra prabhu haẏa tā-sabhāẏa || 571 ||

kateka dvapara kali satya treta yaya — many Dvaparas, Kalis, Satyas, Tretas pass; amsha-avatara prabhu haya — the Lord appears as partial avataras; ta-sabhaya — in all of them

571Many Dvaparas, Kalis, Satyas and Tretas pass —
in all of them the Lord appears as partial avataras.

এই দ্বাপরে আর এই কলিযুগে ।
কৃষ্ণ কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য মিলে বড় ভাগে ॥ ৫৭২ ॥

ei dbāpare āra ei kaliyuge |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇacaitanya mile baṛa bhāge || 572 ||

ei dvapare — in this Dvapara; ara ei kaliyuge — and in this Kali-yuga; krishna krishnachaitanya — Krishna and Krishna Chaitanya; mile bada bhage — are met by great fortune

572In this Dvapara and in this Kali-yuga,
by great fortune, one meets Krishna and Krishna Chaitanya.

ব্রহ্মার দিবসে অবতার একবার ।
দ্বাপরেতে কলিযুগে করেন বিহার ॥ ৫৭৩ ॥

brahmāra dibase abatāra ekabāra |
dbāparete kaliyuge karena bihāra || 573 ||

brahmara divase — in a day of Brahma; avatara ekabara — the descent occurs once; dvaparete kaliyuge — in the Dvapara and Kali-yuga; karena vihara — He sports

573In one day of Brahma He descends once
and sports in the Dvapara and in the Kali-yuga.

বৈবস্বত-মন্বন্তরে শ্যাম গৌর হঞা ।
দ্বাপরের পূজা কৈলা কীর্তন করিয়া ॥ ৫৭৪ ॥

baibasbata-manbantare śyāma gaura hañā |
dbāparera pūjā kailā kīrtana kariẏā || 574 ||

vaivasvata-manvantare — in the Vaivasvata manvantara; shyama gaura hana — becoming dark and golden; dvaparera puja kaila — performed the worship (dharma) of the Dvapara; kirtana kariya — [and] doing kirtana

574In the manvantara of Vaivasvata, becoming dark and golden,
He performed the worship (service), [the dharma] of the Dvapara, and [in the Kali] kirtana.

ধন্য ধন্য কলিযুগ যুগের উপরি ।
সঙ্কীর্তন-যজ্ঞে সভে হৈলা অধিকারী ॥ ৫৭৫ ॥

dhanya dhanya kaliyuga yugera upari |
saṅkīrtana-yajñe sabhe hailā adhikārī || 575 ||

dhanya dhanya kaliyuga — blessed is the Kali-yuga; yugera upari — above all yugas; sankirtana-yajne — in the sacrifice of sankirtana; sabhe haila adhikari — all became qualified

575Blessed, blessed is the Kali-yuga — above all the yugas:
in the sacrifice of sankirtana all became qualified to take part.

আরে আরে দয়াল ঠাকুর গৌরচন্দ্র ।
সঙ্কীর্তনে পার কৈল পঙ্গু জড় অন্ধ ॥ ৫৭৬ ॥

āre āre daẏāla ṭhākura gauracandra |
saṅkīrtane pāra kaila paṅgu jaṛa andha || 576 ||

are are — O, O; dayala thakura gaurachandra — merciful Lord Gaurachandra; sankirtane — by sankirtana; para kaila — carried across; pangu jada andha — the lame, the dull, the blind

576O, O merciful Lord Gaurachandra!
By sankirtana He carried across [the ocean of the world] the lame, the dull and the blind.

আমার বচনে যদি না যাহ প্রতীত ।
যে কিছু পুছিয়ে তাহা কহ সমুচিত ॥ ৫৭৭ ॥

āmāra bacane yadi nā yāha pratīta |
ye kichu puchiẏe tāhā kaha samucita || 577 ||

amara vachane — in my words; yadi na yaha pratita — if you do not trust; ye kichhu puchhiye — what I shall ask; taha kaha samuchita — answer that properly

577If you do not trust my words,
then answer properly what I shall ask.

যে যুগে যাহার যেই আছে বর্ণ-ধর্ম ।
যুগ-অবতারে প্রভু করে সেই কর্ম ॥ ৫৭৮ ॥

ye yuge yāhāra yei āche barṇa-dharma |
yuga-abatāre prabhu kare sei karma || 578 ||

ye yuge — in whichever yuga; yahara yei achhe varna-dharma — whatever colour and dharma belong to it; yuga-avatare — as the yuga-avatara; prabhu kare sei karma — the Lord does that work

578Whatever colour and dharma belong to a yuga,
that work the Lord performs as the avatara of the yuga.

দ্বাপরে ঠাকুর কৃষ্ণ যুগ-অবতার ।
যুগধর্ম-আচরণে কি কৈল আচার ॥ ৫৭৯ ॥

dbāpare ṭhākura kṛṣṇa yuga-abatāra |
yugadharma-ācaraṇe ki kaila ācāra || 579 ||

dvapare — in the Dvapara; thakura krishna yuga-avatara — the Lord Krishna was the yuga-avatara; yugadharma-acharane — in practising the dharma of the age; ki kaila achara — what did He do

579In the Dvapara the Lord Krishna was the avatara of the yuga:
how then did He carry out the dharma of the age?

দ্বাপরে পরিচর্যা-ধর্ম শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
কোথা ধর্মসংস্থাপন কৈল প্রভু তাহে ॥ ৫৮০ ॥

dbāpare paricaryā-dharma śāstre kahe |
kothā dharmasaṃsthāpana kaila prabhu tāhe || 580 ||

dvapare — in the Dvapara; paricharya-dharma — the dharma is service; shastre kahe — the shastras say; kotha dharma-samsthapana — where the establishing of dharma; kaila prabhu tahe — did the Lord accomplish in it

580The shastras say that in the Dvapara the dharma is service (paricharya);
where did the Lord establish this dharma?

অবজ্ঞা না করহ বোলোঁ এক বোল ।
যুক্তিপর কহোঁ কথা না ঠেলিহ মোর ॥ ৫৮১ ॥

abajñā nā karaha boloṁ eka bola |
yuktipara kahoṁ kathā nā ṭheliha mora || 581 ||

avajna na karaha — if you will not disdain; bolon eka bola — I shall say one word; yuktipara kahon katha — I speak with reason; na theliha mora — do not reject mine

581If you will not disdain it, I shall say one thing;
I speak with reason — do not reject my words.

আপনে ঠাকুর সেই স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর ।
কার্য কিবা যুগধর্ম সব তাঁর ভার ॥ ৫৮২ ॥

āpane ṭhākura sei sbatantra īśbara |
kārya kibā yugadharma saba tāṁra bhāra || 582 ||

apane thakura sei — He Himself is the Lord; svatantra ishvara — the independent Ishvara; karya kiva yugadharma — whether special purpose or dharma of the age; saba tanra bhara — all is His charge

582He Himself is the Lord, the independent Ishvara;
both the special purpose and the dharma of the age are all in His hands.

যুগধর্মসংস্থাপন কৈল যেবা কার্য ।
সকল করিল প্রভু বুঝিতে আশ্চর্য ॥ ৫৮৩ ॥

yugadharmasaṃsthāpana kaila yebā kārya |
sakala karila prabhu bujhite āścarya || 583 ||

yugadharma-samsthapana — the establishment of the dharma of the age; kaila yeba karya — and whatever purpose; sakala karila prabhu — the Lord accomplished all; bujhite ashcharya — wonderful to understand

583The establishment of the dharma of the age and every special purpose —
all this the Lord accomplished; it is wonderful to comprehend!

রাধাকৃষ্ণ-অবতার করিতে বিহার ।
আপনে স্বতন্ত্র রাধা প্রকৃতি-আকার ॥ ৫৮৪ ॥

rādhākṛṣṇa-abatāra karite bihāra |
āpane sbatantra rādhā prakṛti-ākāra || 584 ||

radhakrishna-avatara — the descent of Radha-Krishna; karite vihara — to sport; apane svatantra — He Himself independent; radha prakriti-akara — Radha in the form of prakriti

584To sport by descending as Radha-Krishna,
He Himself is the independent [Lord], and Radha is in the form of [His] prakriti.9

প্রকৃতি পুরুষ যেন দোঁহে আত্মা তনু ।
দোঁহে এক তনু কার্য বুঝি হৈলা ভিনু ॥ ৫৮৫ ॥

prakṛti puruṣa yena doṁhe ātmā tanu |
doṁhe eka tanu kārya bujhi hailā bhinu || 585 ||

prakriti purusha yena — like prakriti and purusha; donhe atma tanu — the two are soul and body; donhe eka tanu — both are one body; karya bujhi — understanding the purpose; haila bhinu — became separate

585Like prakriti and purusha, They are soul and body;
both are one body, but, understanding the purpose [of the pastimes], They became two.

রাধা-নাম ধরে কৃষ্ণ-আরাধনা-কাজ ।
পরিচর্যা করে লঞা গোপিকা-সমাজ ॥ ৫৮৬ ॥

rādhā-nāma dhare kṛṣṇa-ārādhanā-kāja |
paricaryā kare lañā gopikā-samāja || 586 ||

radha-nama dhare — bears the name Radha; krishna-aradhana-kaja — [Her] task is the worship of Krishna; paricharya kare — She serves; lana gopika-samaja — together with the society of gopis

586She bears the name Radha because Her task is the worship (aradhana) of Krishna;
She serves Him together with the society of the gopis.

প্রেমভক্তি করে গোপী শত শত শাখা ।
প্রকৃতি-স্বরূপ সেই একলা রাধিকা ॥ ৫৮৭ ॥

premabhakti kare gopī śata śata śākhā |
prakṛti-sbarūpa sei ekalā rādhikā || 587 ||

premabhakti kare gopi — the gopis serve with loving devotion; shata shata shakha — hundreds upon hundreds of branches; prakriti-svarupa — the essence of prakriti; sei ekala radhika — is Radhika alone

587The gopis, hundreds upon hundreds of branches, serve with prema and devotion;
but the very essence of [His] prakriti is Radhika alone.

করণ সমর্পয়ে দেহ দেহের স্বভাব ।
নিত্য নূতন তায় বাঢ়ে অনুরাগ ॥ ৫৮৮ ॥

karaṇa samarpaẏe deha dehera sbabhāba |
nitya nūtana tāẏa bāṛhe anurāga || 588 ||

karana — the senses; samarpaye — She offers; deha — the body; dehera svabhava — the nature of the body; nitya nutana — ever new; taya badhe anuraga — in this anuraga (love) grows

588She offers [Him] Her senses, Her body, the very nature of Her body;
and in this Her ever-new love (anuraga) grows.

এই পরিচর্যা-ধর্ম না বুঝিল কেহ ।
এই কথা কহে যত ভাগবত সেহ ॥ ৫৮৯ ॥

ei paricaryā-dharma nā bujhila keha |
ei kathā kahe yata bhāgabata seha || 589 ||

ei paricharya-dharma — this dharma of service; na bujhila keha — no one understood; ei katha kahe — so say; yata bhagavata seha — all the bhagavatas (devotees; or: the Bhagavata)

589No one understood this dharma of service;
so say all the bhagavatas.10

আর আর দ্বাপরযুগে অংশে করে কর্ম ।
ধর্মসংস্থাপন করে না বুঝয়ে মর্ম ॥ ৫৯০ ॥

āra āra dbāparayuge aṃśe kare karma |
dharmasaṃsthāpana kare nā bujhaẏe marma || 590 ||

ara ara dvaparayuge — in other Dvapara-yugas; amshe kare karma — He acts through a portion; dharma-samsthapana kare — establishes dharma; na bujhaye marma — [people] do not grasp its essence

590In other Dvapara-yugas He acts through a portion
and establishes dharma, [but people] do not grasp its essence.

ধর্ম বলি দান ব্রত তপোধর্ম কহি ।
ধর্ম করি সমর্পণ করে সভে তাহি ॥ ৫৯১ ॥

dharma bali dāna brata tapodharma kahi |
dharma kari samarpaṇa kare sabhe tāhi || 591 ||

dharma bali — calling it dharma; dana vrata tapadharma kahi — they speak of charity, vows, austerity; dharma kari — doing dharma; samarpana kare sabhe tahi — all offer it to Him

591Charity, vows and austerity are called dharma,
and all, having performed dharma, offer [its fruit] to Him.

এই ত কারণে প্রভু প্রকাশিল নিজ ।
তবু না বুঝিল কেহ ধর্মাধর্ম-বীজ ॥ ৫৯২ ॥

ei ta kāraṇe prabhu prakāśila nija |
tabu nā bujhila keha dharmādharma-bīja || 592 ||

ei ta karane — for this very reason; prabhu prakashila nija — the Lord revealed Himself; tabu na bujhila keha — still no one understood; dharmadharma-bija — the seed of dharma and adharma

592That is why the Lord revealed Himself in person;
and still no one understood the root of dharma and adharma.

কলিযুগে গৌরদেহ প্রকাশে আপনা ।
যুগ-অবতার-কার্য প্রকাশয়ে প্রেমা ॥ ৫৯৩ ॥

kaliyuge gauradeha prakāśe āpanā |
yuga-abatāra-kārya prakāśaẏe premā || 593 ||

kaliyuge — in the Kali-yuga; gauradeha prakashe apana — reveals Himself in a golden body; yuga-avatara-karya — [as] the work of the yuga-avatara; prakashaye prema — reveals prema

593In the Kali-yuga He reveals Himself in a golden body
and, doing the work of the yuga-avatara, reveals prema.

রাধার বরণে অঙ্গ গৌর অঙ্গ হঞা ।
রাধিকার ভাব রস অন্তরে করিয়া ॥ ৫৯৪ ॥

rādhāra baraṇe aṅga gaura aṅga hañā |
rādhikāra bhāba rasa antare kariẏā || 594 ||

radhara barane anga — a body of Radha's complexion; gaura anga hana — becoming golden-limbed; radhikara bhava rasa — Radhika's feelings and rasa; antare kariya — holding within

594His body has Radha's complexion — He became golden,
holding within His heart Radhika's feelings and rasa.

সেই ভাবে কান্দে এই রসিক-শেখর ।
বিকশিত পুলক-কদম্ব কলেবর ॥ ৫৯৫ ॥

sei bhābe kānde ei rasika-śekhara |
bikaśita pulaka-kadamba kalebara || 595 ||

sei bhave — in that mood; kande ei rasika-shekhara — this crown of rasikas weeps; vikashita pulaka-kadamba — like a blossoming kadamba, thrilling; kalevara — the body

595In that mood He weeps, the crown of the relishers of rasa;
His body is like a blossoming kadamba, all thrilling.

সেই প্রেমে গরগর মাতোয়াল হঞা ।
হুঙ্কার গর্জন করে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ৫৯৬ ॥

sei preme garagara mātoẏāla hañā |
huṅkāra garjana kare kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 596 ||

sei preme — with that prema; garagara — brimming; matoyala hana — intoxicated; hunkara garjana kare — roars and thunders; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping

596Intoxicated with that prema, brimming over with it,
He roars and thunders, weeping and weeping.

সেই গর্জন শুনি অচেতন কলিকাল ।
চেতন পাইয়া সভে আনন্দ বিশাল ॥ ৫৯৭ ॥

sei garjana śuni acetana kalikāla |
cetana pāiẏā sabhe ānanda biśāla || 597 ||

sei garjana shuni — hearing that roar; achetana kalikala — the senseless age of Kali; chetana paiya sabhe — all regained consciousness; ananda vishala — the joy was vast

597Hearing that roar, the age of Kali that lay senseless —
all regained consciousness, and the joy was immense.

তেঞি রাধাকৃষ্ণ বলি নাচে কান্দে হাসে ।
অন্ধকার দূরে গেল পাইল প্রকাশে ॥ ৫৯৮ ॥

teñi rādhākṛṣṇa bali nāce kānde hāse |
andhakāra dūre gela pāila prakāśe || 598 ||

teni — therefore; radhakrishna bali — crying "Radha-Krishna"; nache kande hase — they dance, weep, laugh; andhakara dure gela — the darkness went away; paila prakashe — they gained light

598Therefore, crying "Radha-Krishna", they dance, weep and laugh;
the darkness went away and they found light.

দ্বাপরে উপজে কৃষ্ণ গৌরময় তনু ।
কলি অচেতন লোক করাইল চেতন ॥ ৫৯৯ ॥

dbāpare upaje kṛṣṇa gauramaẏa tanu |
kali acetana loka karāila cetana || 599 ||

dvapare upaje krishna — Krishna, born in the Dvapara; gauramaya tanu — in a golden body; kali achetana loka — the senseless people of Kali; karaila chetana — awakened

599Krishna, born in the Dvapara, [now] in a golden body
awakened the senseless people of the Kali.

প্রেম প্রকাশয়ে প্রভু করি দীনভাব ।
আপনা বিলায় আপে মানে নিজ লাভ ॥ ৬০০ ॥

prema prakāśaẏe prabhu kari dīnabhāba |
āpanā bilāẏa āpe māne nija lābha || 600 ||

prema prakashaye prabhu — the Lord reveals prema; kari dinabhava — assuming humility; apana vilaya ape — gives Himself away Himself; mane nija labha — counts it His gain

600The Lord reveals prema, assuming a humble guise;
He gives Himself away and counts it His own gain.

এহেন ঠাকুর কোন্ কৈল ঠাকুরাল ।
না ভজিলে প্রেম দেয় নাহিক বিচার ॥ ৬০১ ॥

ehena ṭhākura kon kaila ṭhākurāla |
nā bhajile prema deẏa nāhika bicāra || 601 ||

ehena thakura — such lordship; kon kaila thakurala — what lord ever showed; na bhajile — even to those who do not worship; prema deya — He gives prema; nahika vichara — without discrimination

601What lord ever showed such lordship?
He gives prema even to those who do not worship Him — without discrimination.

এতেক বোলিয়ে যুগ-অবতার এই ।
এই পূর্ণ অবতার প্রকাশিল সেই ॥ ৬০২ ॥

eteka boliẏe yuga-abatāra ei |
ei pūrṇa abatāra prakāśila sei || 602 ||

eteka boliye — therefore I say; yuga-avatara ei — this is the yuga-avatara; ei purna avatara — this full avatara; prakashila sei — He manifested

602That is why I say: this is the avatara of the yuga;
and He also manifested this full avatara.

আর কলিযুগে নারায়ণ-অবতার ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ দ্বাপরযুগে নাম সে তাহার ॥ ৬০৩ ॥

āra kaliyuge nārāẏaṇa-abatāra |
śrīkṛṣṇa dbāparayuge nāma se tāhāra || 603 ||

ara kaliyuge — in other Kali-yugas; narayana-avatara — an avatara of Narayana; shrikrishna — Sri Krishna; dvaparayuge — [as] in the Dvapara-yuga; nama se tahara — such is His name

603In other Kali-yugas, however, there is an avatara of Narayana;
His name is Krishna, as in the Dvapara-yuga.11

শুকপক্ষ-পাখা জিনি বরণ যাহার ।
ইন্দ্রনীলমণি-দ্যুতি কহে টীকাকার ॥ ৬০৪ ॥

śukapakṣa-pākhā jini baraṇa yāhāra |
indranīlamaṇi-dyuti kahe ṭīkākāra || 604 ||

shukapaksha-pakha jini — surpassing a parrot's wing; barana yahara — whose colour; indranila-mani-dyuti — the lustre of sapphire; kahe tikakara — says the commentator

604His colour surpasses a parrot's wing —
"the lustre of sapphire", says the commentator.

এই কলিযুগে গৌরচন্দ্র পূর্ণব্রহ্ম ।
অংশ প্রবেশিল ইথে কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ৬০৫ ॥

ei kaliyuge gauracandra pūrṇabrahma |
aṃśa prabeśila ithe kahila e marma || 605 ||

ei kaliyuge — in this Kali-yuga; gaurachandra purnabrahma — Gaurachandra is the full Brahman; amsha praveshila ithe — the portion entered into Him; kahila e marma — I have told this essence

605In this Kali-yuga Gaurachandra is the full Brahman, and the portion [— the yuga-avatara —] entered into Him: this is the essence I have told.12

পূর্ণ পূর্ণ অবতার চৈতন্য গোসাঞি ।
এহেন করুণানিধি আর কেহ নাঞি ॥ ৬০৬ ॥

pūrṇa pūrṇa abatāra caitanya gosāñi |
ehena karuṇānidhi āra keha nāñi || 606 ||

purna purna avatara — the fullest of full avataras; chaitanya gosani — Chaitanya Gosani; ehena karunanidhi — such an ocean of compassion; ara keha nani — there is no one else

606Chaitanya Gosani is the fullest of full avataras;
there is no one else who is such an ocean of compassion.

কার্য-অবতার যুগ-অবতারে এক ।
যুগ-অনুরূপ তেঞি গৌর পরতেখ ॥ ৬০৭ ॥

kārya-abatāra yuga-abatāre eka |
yuga-anurūpa teñi gaura paratekha || 607 ||

karya-avatara yuga-avatare eka — karya-avatara and yuga-avatara are one; yuga-anurupa — in accordance with the yuga; teni — therefore; gaura paratekha — Gaura is manifest before the eyes

607Karya-avatara and yuga-avatara are one in Him;
therefore, in accordance with the yuga, Gaura is manifest before our eyes.

কলি পীত সঙ্কীর্তন-ধর্ম শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
এই বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু কভু আন নহে ॥ ৬০৮ ॥

kali pīta saṅkīrtana-dharma śāstre kahe |
ei biśbambhara prabhu kabhu āna nahe || 608 ||

kali pita — in the Kali, golden; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma is sankirtana; shastre kahe — the shastras say; ei vishvambhara prabhu — this is the Lord Vishvambhara; kabhu ana nahe — none other

608The shastras say: in the Kali [the avatara] is golden, the dharma is sankirtana;13 this is the Lord Vishvambhara, and no one else."

বিচারি পণ্ডিত সব দঢ়াইল হিয়া ।
আপনা সম্বরে প্রভু সে কাল বুঝিয়া ॥ ৬০৯ ॥

bicāri paṇḍita saba daṛhāila hiẏā |
āpanā sambare prabhu se kāla bujhiẏā || 609 ||

vichari — having reflected; pandita saba dadhaila hiya — all the pandits became firm at heart; apana sambare prabhu — the Lord restrains Himself; se kala bujhiya — understanding the time

609Having reflected, all the pandits became firm in heart;
and the Lord, understanding the time, restrained Himself.

সব সম্বরিল প্রভু তিলেকে তখন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর গৌরহরি উঠিল বচন ॥ ৬১০ ॥

saba sambarila prabhu tileke takhana |
biśbambhara gaurahari uṭhila bacana || 610 ||

saba sambarila prabhu — the Lord withdrew everything; tileke takhana — then in a moment; vishvambhara gaurahari — Vishvambhara Gaurahari; uthila vachana — speech arose (He spoke)

610Then in a moment the Lord withdrew it all,
and Vishvambhara Gaurahari spoke [as usual].

সব লোক কাণাকাণি অপরূপ কথা ।
সাতে পাঁচে অনুমানি যায় যথা তথা ॥ ৬১১ ॥

saba loka kāṇākāṇi aparūpa kathā |
sāte pāṁce anumāni yāẏa yathā tathā || 611 ||

saba loka kanakani — all the people whisper; aparupa katha — about the wondrous event; sate panche anumani — guessing this way and that; yaya yatha tatha — go here and there

611All the people whisper to one another about the wondrous event;
guessing this way and that, they go off here and there.

আশ্চর্য থাকিল কারো সন্দেহ হৃদয় ।
কি দেখিল বিশ্বম্ভর-চরিত্র-আশয় ॥ ৬১২ ॥

āścarya thākila kāro sandeha hṛdaẏa |
ki dekhila biśbambhara-caritra-āśaẏa || 612 ||

ashcharya thakila karo — some remained amazed; sandeha hridaya — with doubt in their hearts; ki dekhila — what have we seen; vishvambhara-charitra-ashaya — the intent behind Vishvambhara's deeds

612Some remained in amazement, with doubt in their hearts:
"What have we seen? What lies behind Vishvambhara's deeds?"

লোকমুখে যে শুনিল বিশ্বম্ভর-কথা ।
সাক্ষাৎ দেখিল এই জগত-করতা ॥ ৬১৩ ॥

lokamukhe ye śunila biśbambhara-kathā |
sākṣāt dekhila ei jagata-karatā || 613 ||

lokamukhe ye shunila — what they had heard from people; vishvambhara-katha — about Vishvambhara; sakshat dekhila — they saw directly; ei jagata-karata — this is the Creator of the world

613What they had heard from people about Vishvambhara
they saw with their own eyes: He is the Creator of the world.

আনন্দে ভরল পুরী দেই জয় জয় ।
ধন্য গোরাগুণগাথা এ লোচনে গায় ॥ ৬১৪ ॥

ānande bharala purī dei jaẏa jaẏa |
dhanya gorāguṇagāthā e locane gāẏa || 614 ||

anande bharala puri — the town overflowed with joy; dei jaya jaya — they cry "jaya, jaya"; dhanya goraguna-gatha — the blessed song of Gora's glories; e lochane gaya — this Lochana sings

614The town overflowed with joy, all cry "Jaya, jaya!";
the blessed song of Gora's glories is sung by this Lochana.

✦

Notes

  1. Adhivasa is a preparatory rite on the eve of a samskara, with anointing with fragrances and the distribution of auspicious gifts.
  2. The nandimukha-shraddha is an offering to the ancestors performed before a samskara (upanayana, wedding and the like).
